lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of roughly vertical columns of high-luminance, circular white spots. Each column contains between 3 to 5 distinct centroids, with the most defined clusters located in the mid-flank region posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity run perpendicular to the longitudinal axis, intersecting with the circular blobs. The blobs are positioned precisely on these vertical lines, forming a structured grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges are visible running along the flank; a primary ridge is positioned along the upper third of the body, exhibiting a sharp transition from high luminance on its dorsal edge to a shadow-cast gradient on its ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a low-density distribution of smaller, less-defined high-luminance spots concentrated toward the trailing edge and upper half of the fin silhouette.
